desc: Write a function to compute GCD of X and Y.
Parse input: N, X, Y, S, T.
Count zeros in S and T; if counts differ, print "No" and exit.
Collect indices (1-based) of all '0' characters in S into a list `zeros_S`.
Collect indices (1-based) of all '0' characters in T into a list `zeros_T`.
Iterate through the lists, checking if `zeros_S[i] % G == zeros_T[i] % G` for all i.
If all checks pass, print "Yes"; otherwise, print "No".
